parameters.content:
Reusable Taxonomy Lookup (single source of truth)

Resolves one raw attribute value to its canonical taxonomy entry using ONLY the
Data Tables tbk_taxonomy_attributes + tbk_taxonomy_synonyms. No taxonomy values
are hardcoded. Deterministic match order: exact canonical_value, then synonym.
Always returns exactly one item; never throws. Reused by every downstream TBK
workflow (Attribute Intelligence, Product Intelligence, Cake Genome, SEO,
Shopify, Recommendations).
